about.description: Wacked Out Weiner Gulf Shores opened on March 1, 2018. Owned and operated by Jimmy Williams, originally from East Alabama who made Gulf Shores his home in 2017. The restaurant provides an affordable, fun, and casual dining experience focused on customizable hot dogs and sausages. The business has won several awards including 'Best Hot Dog Joint in Alabama' and prides itself on relationships with customers, community, and local school system.
about.elevator_pitch: An affordable, fun, and casual hot dog joint on the Gulf Coast with unlimited toppings and a strong community focus.
about.vibe: Casual, fun, family-friendly local favorite with a strong emphasis on community relationships
about.insider_tip: Try the Wackinator Weiner Hot Dog Challenge if you're feeling adventurous
